name: the "#" source stacks nothing
why: Without the source's stack the event card never shows above the release group card.

name: a repaint may start the event lookup
why: The engine's rule: only a show asks. A failed lookup's repaint would ask again, and again (the 503 loop the docs record).
grep: a failed lookup says so, and a repaint does not ask again

name: the event target stays on the event link
why: Its request is wanted only while a card shows for its element (_mbPopWanted()); the event link has no card, so the lookup is dropped at its rate slot and the box stays loading.

why: sa_event_rg_event_card off must show the release group card alone and ask nothing.

name: the stacked box has no kind line

name: the event card is read from any event link of the row
why: Only the "Recorded at event" column names the track's event: the title cell's own relationships (dl.ars) link events too, so with the column's link gone the row still showed a card.
